The '''Nem'ro clan''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan, or [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. One of its members was the Hutt [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Suudaa]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].
